resources.string: Blocks adult searches and explicit content across all apps and browsers (including Incognito). Blocks any apps you choose completely, and guards searches inside the rest. Monitors search fields and address bars in real-time with zero network latency.

FocusLock blocks adult searches and explicit sites on this device. To do that, with your permission it will:

- Read text you type in search fields and browser address bars to detect blocked words. Nothing else is read and nothing is stored. Only words you type can trigger a block. Just reading pages, quizzes or articles never does.
- Take you to the Home screen the moment a blocked word is typed, an adult site is opened, or the blocked X app is launched.
- Guard its own settings page, the Private DNS page and the uninstall screen while protection is on, so it cannot be silently switched off.
- Show you a personal support message when a bypass is attempted.
- Block completely any apps you choose, and let you switch search-word checking on or off per app.

All checking happens on this device only. No accounts, no servers, no tracking, no data leaves your phone. You can switch protection off at any time from system Accessibility settings.

FocusLock collects no personal data.

- Everything the app checks (typed words, visited addresses) is processed in memory on your device and never saved, uploaded or shared.
- The blocked-attempts log lives only in the running app and is cleared when the app closes.
- Private DNS filtering is performed by Android and your chosen DNS provider, not by this app.
- No accounts, no analytics, no advertising identifiers, no third-party SDKs.

If you have questions, contact the developer through the Play Store listing.

أنا بعرف ليش إنت هون هسا. مو لأنك شخص سيئ — لأنك بيوم من الأيام قررت إنك تكون أحسن، ونزلت هالتطبيق عشان يساعدك بالضبط بهاي اللحظة، لحظة الضعف.

تذكر شعورك بعد آخر مرة: الندم، والقرف من حالك، والوعد اللي وعدته إنها آخر مرة. هاد الشعور حقيقي، وهو أصدق بكتير من الرغبة اللي حاسسها هسا. الرغبة بتروح بعد عشر دقايق، بس الندم بضل أيام وانت بتعرف هاد الاشي منيح.

الله شايفك هسا، ولسا باب التوبة مفتوح. قال تعالى: قل للمؤمنين يغضوا من أبصارهم ويحفظوا فروجهم. إنت مش لحالك بهالمعركة، وكل مرة بتقاوم فيها إنت أقوى من اللي قبلها، حتى لو وقعت قبل هيك ألف مرة.

سكر هالصفحة. قوم توضا. اطلع امشي. احكي مع حدا بتحبه. لا تضل لحالك مع التلفون بإيدك، لأن الوحدة والفراغ هم أول الطريق.

القرار قرارك يا صاحبي، وأنا هون بس عشان أذكرك فيه قبل ما تندم.

🔒 FocusLock - Complete Setup Guide

Step 1: Enable Accessibility Service

  1. Open Settings → Accessibility → Installed Services
  2. Find FocusLock Content Blocker and toggle it ON
  3. Confirm the permission dialog

Step 2: Configure Private DNS (Network-Level Filtering)

This provides system-wide blocking WITHOUT any VPN, keeping 100% network speed.

Option A: Cloudflare Family DNS (Recommended — does not break YouTube)

  1. Settings → Network & Internet → Private DNS
  2. Select Private DNS provider hostname
  3. Enter: family.cloudflare-dns.com
  4. Save

Option B: AdGuard Family DNS (stronger, may break YouTube Live)

  1. Settings → Network & Internet → Private DNS
  2. Select Private DNS provider hostname
  3. Enter: family.adguard-dns.com
  4. Save

Alternative (IP-based): If hostname fails, use DNS-over-HTTPS in browser settings or use DNS changer apps that support DoH/DoT with these IPs:

  • AdGuard Family: 94.140.14.15 / 94.140.15.16
  • Cloudflare Family: 1.1.1.3 / 1.0.0.3

Step 3: Verify Protection

  • Open any browser (Chrome, Firefox, Incognito mode)
  • Try searching for blocked terms - should redirect to home screen instantly
  • Try navigating to adult domains - blocked at DNS level
  • Test X (Twitter) and Instagram search bars

How It Works

  • On-device: AccessibilityService monitors EditText, address bars, search fields in real-time (O(1) HashSet lookup)
  • Network-level: Private DNS blocks adult domains before connection (zero VPN, full speed)
  • Combined: Dual-layer protection - catches both search queries and direct navigation

Performance

  • ~50ms notification timeout
  • ConcurrentHashMap for thread-safe O(1) keyword lookup
  • Recycles AccessibilityNodeInfo to prevent memory leaks
  • No background threads, no VPN overhead

Troubleshooting

  • Service keeps turning off: Disable battery optimization for FocusLock
  • Private DNS not working: Some carriers block DoT - use DNS changer app with DoH
  • False positives: Report via app feedback - we refine keyword list regularly
